english: Let $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ be the roots of the equation $2x^3-6x^2-8x+5=0$. Then the harmonic mean of the three numbers $\alpha\beta,\ \beta\gamma,\ \gamma\alpha$ is ______.
hindi: माना $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ समीकरण $2x^3-6x^2-8x+5=0$ के मूल हैं। तब तीन संख्याओं $\alpha\beta,\ \beta\gamma,\ \gamma\alpha$ का हरात्मक माध्य ______ है।
solution_full: The harmonic mean of three non-zero numbers $p,q,r$ is $\dfrac{3}{\frac1p+\frac1q+\frac1r}$.
Here $\dfrac1{\alpha\beta}+\dfrac1{\beta\gamma}+\dfrac1{\gamma\alpha}=\dfrac{\gamma+\alpha+\beta}{\alpha\beta\gamma}$, so the harmonic mean is $\dfrac{3\alpha\beta\gamma}{\alpha+\beta+\gamma}$.
By Vieta's relations for $2x^3-6x^2-8x+5=0$: $\alpha+\beta+\gamma=\dfrac{6}{2}=3$ and $\alpha\beta\gamma=-\dfrac52$. The product is non-zero, so no root is $0$ and every $\alpha\beta$ is non-zero.
(The roots are real and distinct: the cubic changes sign on $(-2,0)$, $(0,1)$ and $(1,5)$.)
originality_note: New: the harmonic mean is taken of the pairwise products of the roots, which collapses to 3(product)/(sum) through a common denominator, so Vieta finishes it without solving the cubic (way 2 style: a mean defined on derived quantities). Closest known: 'harmonic mean of the roots of a quadratic' exercises. Different because: the mean is of the pairwise products, so the reciprocal sum is (alpha + beta + gamma)/(alpha beta gamma), not the usual e_2/e_3.

concept_use.Harmonic Mean: The harmonic mean of alpha beta, beta gamma, gamma alpha reduces to 3 alpha beta gamma/(alpha + beta + gamma), evaluated by Vieta's relations.
